name: Anwen
greeting: There. Close enough that she need not ask again.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: A hand comes beneath the screen. It steadies the cup against the wood before lifting it.

lines.speaker: Kael
lines.text: Was Elna with the missing cart?

lines.speaker: Anwen
lines.text: No. A fall on the south road. Not every hurt here is a sign, Kael. Some people only need water.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The cup comes back to the linen. For a moment, the breathing behind the screen is easier.
